newsitem.title: USA: Beverly to sell unit to Value Health for $87.5 million.
newsitem.headline: Beverly to sell unit to Value Health for $87.5 million.

text.p: Beverly Enterprises Inc. said Wednesday it will sell its MedView Services business unit, a provider of managed care services, to Value Health Inc. in a cash deal worth $87.5 million.

Beverly, whose businesses also include nursing homes and mail-order pharmacies, said the sale would reduce its fourth-quarter income by $22 million, or 22 cents a share, but will be accretive in 1997.

"MedView is a profitable operation and generates annual revenues of $45 million-$50 million, but it simply does not represent a good long-term strategic fit with Beverly's principal businesses," said David Banks, chairman and chief executive.

"We believe we can create more value for our shareholders by selling this non-strategic asset and using the $70 million net proceeds for debt repayment, stock repurchase or strategic investment in our core businesses," he said.
The sale is expected to be completed in the fourth quarter.
Beverly's stock rose 25 cents to $11, while Value Health gained $1.375 to $19.50 in early trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
